title: Bug/Hack Problem

replies.author: Javipepe
replies.body:
Greetings xelox.

This tag error is already a known bug which has been reported multiple times at our github issue tracker. We are fully looking into it, but it's a bit tricky to find where it comes from. However, this is definitely not someone hacking so there's nobody to punish. Thanks for providing yet another video of the situation though :)

Regards,
Javi
